schedule.boundary: authenticated frozen L20 output / L21 input
schedule.order: ascending lo + ((hi - lo) * k) // 16 for k=1..15
schedule.exclusions: both executed endpoints and unchanged frozen baseline
schedule.state: copy I/Z/H; change only I[62]; preserve Z; recompute H[62] by RNE16
schedule.precondition: authenticated single passing RNE cell; unchanged full-vector L20 S18 gate
schedule.coverage: 15 strict-interior samples only; no native sufficiency or monotonicity claim

executor.stop: first mandatory failure per probe; BLOCKED or failed L20 precondition aborts batch
executor.output: stdout evidence only; no state archive, successor, publication or admission

reference_policy: unchanged independently propagated original-input global reference
validation: Both commands freshly compile the actual repository candidate/test closure in memory and collect and execute exactly 26 new focused unittest tests once, without failures/errors/skips. Assert absolute interpreter, cwd, explicit command-local PYTHONPATH and all module origins, including tests.test_q24_s16_toward_zero_l3_l8_v1. Upstream suites, including the accepted 19 tests, are imported for origin authentication only, never run. Tests use synthetic drivers with native/external dispatch and state publication blocked. Rebind source/contract/input records before reporting success and after execution.
authentication: Pin the corrected interior preparation, original failed check and missing-executor terminal before parsing. Reconstruct all 15 strict-interior probes from the authenticated frozen L20 I/Z/H parent and exact independently derived interval. Authenticate historical endpoint failures, source closures, contracts, model operands, original reference extension and state/P0-KV lineage through the existing read-only chain. Preserve the old one-error check and both old BLOCKED interfaces exactly; do not replay their tests or relabel them as passing.
execution_boundary: Evaluate all 15 distinct Q24 states in prepared ascending order, excluding both endpoints and the unchanged baseline even when FP16 H agrees. Copy I/Z/H for each probe; change only I[62], preserve Z and recompute H[62] by RNE16. Recheck the original full-vector L20 S18 global precondition without native L20 execution. Only native L21-L23 may run, with immediate actual I/Z/H propagation and own empty P0 prior KV per layer; never consume another layer's KV. Reuse the native-S16-RTZ evaluator, authenticated model tensors, independent same-input local references for S0-S17 and original-input globally propagated binary64-v1 for S18. Stop the candidate on the first mandatory gate failure, then try the next probe; an invalid precondition or BLOCKED exception aborts the batch. Maximum 45 native layer invocations. No baseline or endpoint execution.
output: JSON on stdout and focused-test diagnostics on stderr; this executor writes no files. If separately captured, use fresh ignored build paths only and never replace existing evidence. --check returns INTERIOR_EXECUTOR_READY with zero native execution. --execute reports each candidate's actual layer list, input/output bindings, original references, stage gates and first failure, with aggregate invocation accounting. Failed or incomplete runs remain nonzero; exceptions explicitly report BLOCKED.
result_boundary: BOUNDED_INTERIOR_PROBES_PASS refers only to all 15 sampled suffixes passing unchanged mandatory gates; INTERIOR_GATE_FAIL retains any failed probe. Neither status proves exhaustiveness, minimality, monotonicity, admission or publication. Independent normal Host Reviewer must reproduce the repo-bound validation before acceptance; no self-review substitutes for that path.
claim_boundary: Only isolated versioned native-S16-RTZ Q24/P0 CPU software. Q24 residual state is wider than FP16. Native G128 asymmetric packed INT4, GEMM nibble order, no qzero plus-one, FP16 scales/operator boundaries/KV remain unchanged. Preserve historical failures and bounded Reviewer acceptance. No native L0-L8 replay, RTL, hardware, GPU, FPGA, simulation, synthesis, PPA, strict-FP16-state W4A16, new-token or full-model PASS. No framework, Host-global, model/profile/budget, threshold/precision/reference/review-policy or ACE2 changes.
